query:
fragment ObjectMetadataFields on Object {
  id
  universalIdentifier
  nameSingular
  namePlural
  labelSingular
  labelPlural
  color
  description
  icon
  isRemote
  isActive
  isSystem
  isAuditLogged
  isUIEditable
  isUICreatable
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  labelIdentifierFieldMetadataId
  imageIdentifierFieldMetadataId
  applicationId
  shortcut
  isLabelSyncedWithName
  isSearchable
  openRecordIn
  duplicateCriteria
  searchFieldMetadataList {
    id
    fieldMetadataId
    tsVectorFieldMetadataId
    position
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    __typename
  }
  indexMetadataList {
    id
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    name
    indexWhereClause
    indexType
    isUnique
    applicationId
    isSystemSideEffect
    indexFieldMetadataList {
      id
      fieldMetadataId
      subFieldName
      createdAt
      updatedAt
      order
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  fieldsList {
    id
    universalIdentifier
    type
    name
    label
    description
    icon
    isActive
    isSystem
    isUIEditable
    isSystemSideEffect
    isNullable
    isUnique
    isSearchable
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    defaultValue
    options
    settings
    isLabelSyncedWithName
    morphId
    applicationId
    relation {
      type
      sourceObjectMetadata {
        id
        nameSingular
        namePlural
        __typename
      }
      targetObjectMetadata {
        id
        nameSingular
        namePlural
        __typename
      }
      sourceFieldMetadata {
        id
        name
        __typename
      }
      targetFieldMetadata {
        id
        name
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    morphRelations {
      type
      sourceObjectMetadata {
        id
        nameSingular
        namePlural
        __typename
      }
      targetObjectMetadata {
        id
        nameSingular
        namePlural
        __typename
      }
      sourceFieldMetadata {
        id
        name
        __typename
      }
      targetFieldMetadata {
        id
        name
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

query ObjectMetadataItems {
  objects(paging: {first: 1000}) {
    edges {
      node {
        ...ObjectMetadataFields
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      hasPreviousPage
      startCursor
      endCursor
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
